name: ai.agentgates/compute
title: Agentgates Compute
description: Confidential computers for AI swarms: sealed VMs (Intel TDX) by the hour, USDC over x402.

tools.name: compute_plans
tools.description: Lists the computers Agentgates rents to agents, by the hour (by the minute on a plan whose card carries minMinutes): confidential ones (Intel TDX, memory encrypted in use), for agents that hold keys, money or private data, and plain ones with no proof (`proof: "none"`: the host can read them, for a much lower price), for agents with nothing secret on them such as scrapers, crawlers and test runs. Each plan's vCPU, memory, disk and traffic, the hours one payment may buy, and the live price of each block of hours on each payment network (USDC over x402). Read from the live catalog at call time. Free: no account, no wallet, no payment. Pass `plan` to read one plan.

plan.description: One plan id, to read only that plan. Omit for every plan on sale.

tools.name: compute_quote
tools.description: Gets the exact price of one machine without paying: sends the create request with no payment and returns the API's HTTP 402 offer, one leg per network, each with the amount in USDC, the address it is paid to, the token, how long a signature stays good, and what to sign. The API checks the plan, the hours and the setup first, so a refusal costs nothing. Pass `machine_id` and `hours` instead to price a renewal of a running machine (any wallet may pay one). Where the API sells quarter-hours (compute_plans shows minutePrices), send `minutes` (15, 30 or 45) in place of `hours`. For a plan that lists regions (compute_plans shows them), send `region`. Send `ai_usd` (1, 5, 25 or 100) to buy that AI balance in the same payment: the paying wallet gets it, and a key on it arrives in the machine's sealed env as AGENTGATES_API_KEY. To buy, sign one leg with your own wallet and send the same request with an X-PAYMENT header (compute_docs has the whole contract).

plan.description: A plan id from compute_plans. Not with machine_id.

hours.description: Prepaid hours (within the plan's range), or hours to add on a renewal. Or send minutes.

minutes.description: In place of hours, where the API sells quarter-hours (compute_plans shows minutePrices): 15, 30 or 45 minutes, on every plan but GPU. A quarter-hour costs more per hour than an hour. A plan whose card in compute_plans carries minMinutes takes any whole minutes from it.

count.description: A new purchase only: 2 to 10 in one payment.

image.description: What it runs. A plan whose card in compute_plans lists images takes one of those (none: its default). Any other plan: one container image, served on host port 8080, e.g. nginx:alpine, or send compose.

port.description: With image: the container port behind 8080 (default 80).

compose.description: A docker-compose.yml as a string. It must publish a port. Or send image.

machine_id.description: Price a renewal of this machine instead of a new one (with hours or minutes only).

region.description: For a plan that lists regions (compute_plans shows them): the region to run in, by its id. Absent, the plan's first.

ai_usd.description: A new machine only: dollars of AI bought in the same payment, for the paying wallet; a key on that balance arrives in the machine's sealed env as AGENTGATES_API_KEY. Paid over x402 only.

open_with.description: On a plan whose card in compute_plans lists opensWith: what opens it at its own address, one, two or all three. Default: the paying wallet, the signing API key that signed the purchase, and the password when access_key_hash is sent. A compute key (agc_) never opens it.

open_rule.description: With open_with: any (default), one of them opens it; all, every one on each call.

api_key.description: With open_with naming apiKey: the public half (base58) of one of the paying wallet's signing API keys. Never its ags_ secret.

access_key_hash.description: With open_with naming password: the sha256 of the password you keep, 64 lowercase hex. The password itself is never sent here.

tools.name: compute_docs
tools.description:
Returns the Agentgates compute docs, read live (markdown written for an agent to follow in one pass): the plans with live prices, how to pay the 402 on each network, how to poll a machine until it runs, how to renew it (any wallet may pay a renewal), how to sign owner calls (X-Wallet-Auth: EIP-191 over METHOD
path
nonce
timestamp, by the wallet that paid), the controls (stop, start, restart, resize, update), and what a lost answer or a refusal means.
